value_linkage.curve_denominator: structure replacement cost new of the reference building
value_linkage.share_of_value_priced: structure (100 %) through one unit; sprinkler piping and contents withheld

parameter_tier_table.value: P(burst) = Phi(ln(F / theta_eff) / beta) for F >= floor; DR = P x d_bar
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: SJ's suggested form; a modelling choice (FPR-C001).

parameter_tier_table.value: freezing degree-hours of one spell, outdoor 2 m air, reference 0 degC
parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Gordon supports a dose not a threshold (FPR-C002); outdoor air is not pipe-cavity air.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: A fitted reference temperature (e.g. -6.7 degC, FPR-S011).

parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Freezer-test dose of the pipe surroundings (FPR-C003); used only for the outage median and the floor.
parameter_tier_table.update_trigger: Gordon PDF read; other pipe tests.

parameter_tier_table.reasoning: Fastest freezer blockage dose; even a fully exposed pipe needs about this dose (FPR-C003).
Least protected placement in the south (FPR-C004).
Judgment; pipes placed and protected for long freezes.
Lightly heated, doors open, pipes near exterior walls (FPR-C006).
Envelope lag on the 80 degC h surroundings dose when heat is lost all spell (FPR-C005).
About $30,000 average freeze claim (all coverages) / an assumed $375,000 house RCN (1,700 sq ft x $220 per sq ft) (FPR-C007).
NSI 2026 fullrep RES1 $177-227 per sq ft (illustration); floor area assumed.
Same basis as the other real-estate cells.

evaluation_contract.out_of_range_behavior: dose above 30,000 degC h withholds; negative is an error

emit_contract.withheld_units_emit: explicit null DR plus reason codes; never zero

conditions: every parameter is T4 (judgment); every record answers only with the screening acknowledgement
freezing_degree_hours_degc_h is the freezing degree-hours of one cold spell from outdoor 2 m air below 0 degC
climate_band is the IECC / DOE climate zone of the cell, grouped 1-2, 3, 4-5, 6-8
outage fraction = outage hours / spell hours, rounded up to 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1
DR is a share of the structure's replacement cost new; contents and sprinkler piping withheld
not calibrated: county claim counts for Uri, Elliott and Fern are the calibration path

checks_required: routing by building, climate band and outage band
DR x structure RCN once; all perils in one event at most 100 %
cap_binding.action_if_fail: withhold; do not substitute another record or clamp

required_before_canonical_use: claims calibration (Uri, Elliott, Fern county counts)
Hazard spell layer and climate-zone index (SJ)

derivation_rationale.source_spine: Constructed (no public curve). Dose anchor: Gordon (1996) freezer tests, 77-84 degC h, via SJ v8 §3.3. Form: SJ v8 §3.3. Every parameter T4.
derivation_rationale.uncertainty: one-at-a-time sensitivity only; compounded uncertainty NOT propagated
